title: Works for my needs.
text:
Works for my needs.. The ottoman is okay. I like that is foldable and can be stored if I am traveling in an RV but it is not very sturdy. I would not ever let anyone sit on it. You can put your legs on it and my 28lb dog climbs on it with no issues but it would need to be made with stronger wood if you wanted children to sit on it.

Other than that it is great for storage.

Oh the packaging it came it came sucked.
